title: beyond-wine
description: Claims-based knowledge base for no/low ABV specialty beverages (producers, beverages, people).
summary: Claims-based knowledge base for no/low ABV specialty beverages (producers, beverages, people).
offersHint: Claims-based knowledge base for no/low ABV specialty beverages (producers, beverages, people). · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://beyond.wine/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_claims
toolsPreview.description: Find published Beyond Wine claims by entity type, entity slug, claim type, or reliability class.

toolsPreview.name: get_claim
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a single Beyond Wine claim by claim UID, including provenance and version history.

toolsPreview.name: search_producers
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user asks to list, find, or filter producers by name, country, city, ingredient, or technique. Good matches include 'list producers from France' and 'find producers using sencha tea'.

toolsPreview.name: get_producer
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific producer, such as 'Who is Muri?', 'Tell me about Domaine des Grottes', or 'Fetch the producer profile for Kolonne Null'. The profile includes the producer's full published beverage lineup under data.beverages.

toolsPreview.name: search_beverages
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user asks to list, find, or filter beverages by name, producer, or category. The `q` text matches beverage names, aliases, AND producer names; use `producer` to list a producer's full lineup. Good matches include 'list sparkling beverages', 'find beverages named Pet Nat', and 'list all MURI beverages'.

toolsPreview.name: get_beverage
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific beverage, such as 'Tell me about Pet Nat 0.0' or 'Fetch the beverage profile for Leitz Zero'.

toolsPreview.name: get_entity
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a published entity profile from the Beyond Wine knowledge base, with structured data and attached claims. Profiled entities (producers, beverages, people, restaurants) are independent businesses documented by Beyond Wine, not brands of it.

toolsPreview.name: list_entities
toolsPreview.description: List published entity profiles in the Beyond Wine knowledge base by type.

toolsPreview.name: get_context
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a token-bounded context bundle for a Beyond Wine topic, including entity summary and optional claims or graph data.

toolsPreview.name: get_graph
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve direct relationship neighbors for an entity profiled in the Beyond Wine knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: get_ontology
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the Beyond Wine ontology, entity types, relationship types, and semantic scales.
